Postazione di Controllo Locale

A designated engine room console enabling manual operation and monitoring of main engine or machinery independently of the remote (bridge) controls.

Questions and answers

What is Postazione di Controllo Locale?

In this glossary, Postazione di Controllo Locale refers to: A designated engine room console enabling manual operation and monitoring of main engine or machinery independently of the remote (bridge) controls.

How is Postazione di Controllo Locale used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Passare il funzionamento alla postazione di controllo locale e confermare gli ordini del motore principale direttamente con il personale della sala macchine."

Postazione di Controllo Locale matters because it supports clear communication in Engineering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

A designated engine room console enabling manual operation and monitoring of main engine or machinery independently of the remote (bridge) controls.

Operational example

Switch operation to the local control stand and confirm main engine orders directly with the engine room personnel.

Localized term

Postazione di Controllo Locale

Localized example

Passare il funzionamento alla postazione di controllo locale e confermare gli ordini del motore principale direttamente con il personale della sala macchine.
